remarks:
This 1 acre building lot is located in Caneadea NY, Allegany County.

Enjoy this quiet country setting that is ready for your RV, camper, or weekend camping getaway.  The property includes electric, septic, water and are being sold as-is.  Fiber optic is available at the roadside.  A 12 x 20 concrete pad is in place for an RV or camper, along with a second 8 x 13 concrete pad.  Additional features include an established fire pit area, a 10 x 12 storage shed with a newer metal roof, and three rows of planted Norway Spruce evergreens for added privacy.

An established driveway leads to the gated access, and the property is located on a maintained year-round road for easy access in all seasons.  A recent survey conveys, and all rights will transfer with the sale.

Conveniently located just minutes from Allen State Forest which has 2,421 acres, and Allen Lake, offering nearby hunting, fishing, canoeing, and kayaking.
facts: Rectangular, Rectangular Lot, Rural Lot, Wooded, Level
